description: Machine-verified registry of interfaces that exist in the current repository.

status_definitions.implemented: The callable endpoint, task or event producer exists and serves its documented behavior.
status_definitions.registered_stub: The task name and callable exist but the business workflow is not implemented. A schema-bound stub validates its frozen request and returns a typed SKIPPED result; a name-only deferred stub is disabled and fails closed.
status_definitions.published: The immutable versioned schema is checked in and generated from its contract model.
status_definitions.declared: The public Protocol exists; this does not claim that a production adapter is implemented.

direction_definitions.inbound_use_case: A driving adapter calls this application capability to initiate a use case.
direction_definitions.outbound_dependency: Application or domain code calls this dependency and an adapter supplies it.
direction_definitions.lifecycle_utility: A cross-cutting lifecycle, health, clock, capability or identifier utility.
